name: Bootstrap Theme Toggler
description: Adds a Bootstrap 5 block that toggles the page between light, dark and auto color modes.
project_description: The Bootstrap Color Modes Toggler module provides a simple, plug-and-play solution to add a color-mode switcher to a Bootstrap 5 Drupal theme. It ships one block, "Bootstrap Theme Toggler", that renders a dropdown letting the visitor choose Light, Dark or Auto. The choice sets Bootstrap's `data-bs-theme` attribute on the `<html>` element and is persisted client-side in localStorage (`theme-mode`); Auto follows the operating-system `prefers-color-scheme`. The toggle is entirely front-end: there is no settings form, no permission, and no server-side configuration. Place the block in any region on the Block Layout page and the switcher is immediately available. It requires a Bootstrap 5-based theme (the toggle only affects themes that honor `data-bs-theme`) and the Bootstrap Icons webfont installed under `/libraries/bootstrap-icons` for the sun/moon/auto glyphs.
